query:
INSERT INTO imap_state_entries (link_id, kind, key, folder_id, message_id, document)
        SELECT
            $1,
            'location',
            'inbox:1:' || n,
            'inbox',
            'm:' || lpad(n::text, 6, '0'),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'folder_id', 'inbox',
                'uid_validity', 1,
                'uid', n,
                'message_id', 'm:' || lpad(n::text, 6, '0'),
                'fingerprint', 'fp:' || n
            )
        FROM
            generate_series(1, 100000) n
